name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid to pick one day, several days or a range, on react-day-picker with date-fns, styled with token roles: control-sized day buttons, the accent solid for the chosen day and the accent subtle band for a range.
usage: Use Calendar on its own where the month should stay visible (a history window, a schedule), or let DatePicker open it in a popup next to a text field. Set mode to "single", "multiple" or "range" and pass selected and onSelect as react-day-picker's (Date, Date[] or { from, to }). Limit the choice with disabled matchers ({ before }, { after }, a weekday list), show two months for ranges with numberOfMonths={2}, and pass a date-fns locale for the language and the first day of the week (weekStartsOn overrides it). Give it an aria-label that says what the date is for. To type a date, or to keep the form compact, use DatePicker; for a time of day, TimePicker.

props.name: mode
props.description: What a click selects: one day, a set of days, or the start and end of a range. Without a mode the days are not selectable.

props.name: selected
props.description: The chosen day, days or range ({ from, to }), as the mode says.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the new selection when a day is clicked or chosen with Enter or Space.

props.name: required
props.description: A chosen day cannot be unselected by clicking it again.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Days that cannot be chosen: a Date, { before }, { after }, { from, to }, { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] } or a function.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: The month shown first; month and onMonthChange control it.

props.name: startMonth
props.description: The earliest month navigation reaches; endMonth is the latest.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months side by side; they wrap when the space is narrow.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Shows the days of the previous and next month in color.fg.subtle.

props.name: showWeekNumber
props.description: Adds a column of week numbers.

props.name: locale
props.description: Month and weekday names, labels and the first day of the week.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, over the locale's (1 is Monday).

props.name: footer
props.description: Text under the grid, announced politely (role="status").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the date is for; names the calendar's root.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The calendar, data-slot="calendar"; holds the months, wrapping when narrow.

slots.name: navigation
slots.description: Previous and next month: ghost icon buttons of size.control.sm beside the caption, aria-disabled at startMonth and endMonth.

slots.name: caption
slots.description: The month and year in type.label, a polite live region.

slots.name: grid
slots.description: role="grid": weekday headers in type.caption and color.fg.muted, then a row per week.

parts.name: CalendarDayButton
parts.description: A day: a size.control.md square button in a gridcell; data-selected, data-today, data-outside, data-disabled and data-range-start, -middle, -end show its state. Calendar renders it; pass it as components.DayButton when wrapping it.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a day or a navigation button: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: hover
states.description: A day under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: selected
states.description: A chosen day, or an end of a range: color.accent.bg with its foreground.

states.name: range-middle
states.description: A day inside a range: on the color.accent.subtle-bg band, in color.accent.subtle-fg.

states.name: range-start
states.description: The first day of a range: square on the side the band continues.

states.name: today
states.description: Today: a color.accent.bg border and the strong weight, so it is not marked by colour alone.

states.name: outside
states.description: A day of the previous or next month: color.fg.subtle.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A day that cannot be chosen: color.fg.disabled and struck through.

accessibility: Each month is a role="grid" named by its month; the days are buttons in gridcells whose labels give the full date and say when it is today or selected (aria-selected on the cell).

One day is in the tab order (the chosen day, else today, else the first day); the arrow keys move a day or a week, Home and End to the week's start and end, PageUp and PageDown a month (with Shift a year), and Enter or Space chooses.

The caption is a polite live region, so moving to another month announces it; the navigation buttons are named "Go to the Previous Month" and "Go to the Next Month" (the labels prop renames them) and are aria-disabled at the limits.
Disabled days are skipped as choices and struck through as well as dimmed; today carries a border and the strong weight besides its colour.
Give the calendar an aria-label that says what the date is for; pass a date-fns locale to have the labels in the user's language.
